senses.en: To get someone to do something by giving reasons
To make someone believe something is true

ex.en: I persuaded my brother to join our walking group.
ex.zh: 我说服弟弟加入了我们的步行小组。

ex.en: Public health campaigns can persuade people to adopt healthier habits by explaining the benefits in accessible language.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传可以用通俗语言解释益处，说服人们养成更健康的习惯。

col: persuade someone to do something｜说服某人做某事
persuade someone of something｜使某人相信某事
tip: persuade sb to do强调劝服成功，不只是提出建议。

senses.en: to check that something is true or done

ex.en: Make sure you lock the door before leaving.
ex.zh: 离开前确保锁好门。

ex.en: She made sure all the lights were off.
ex.zh: 她确认所有灯都关了。

tip: make sure (that) + 从句，表示“确保”。
scene: A hand locking a door while holding keys.

senses.en: The sport of competing to move faster than others.
Designed or used for races.

ex.en: My cousin enjoys watching bicycle racing on weekend afternoons.
ex.zh: 我表亲喜欢在周末下午看自行车比赛。

ex.en: Professional motor racing encourages technological innovation, but its environmental impact remains a subject of debate.
ex.zh: 职业赛车运动推动技术创新，但其环境影响仍存在争议。

tip: 作运动名称通常不可数；一场比赛用a race。

senses.en: A weapon designed to explode and cause damage.
To attack a place using bombs.

ex.en: The museum displayed an empty bomb casing behind glass.
ex.zh: 博物馆在玻璃后陈列了一个空炸弹壳。

ex.en: Construction projects may be delayed when workers discover an unexploded bomb left over from a past conflict.
ex.zh: 当工人发现过去冲突遗留的未爆炸弹时，建设项目可能会延期。

col: defuse a bomb｜拆除炸弹引信
a bomb disposal team｜拆弹小组
tip: 词尾b不发音；bombing指轰炸或炸弹袭击。

senses.en: a person trained to treat sick or injured animals
to check someone or something carefully before giving approval

ex.en: The vet gently checked our puppy's ears and paws.
ex.zh: 兽医轻柔地检查了我们小狗的耳朵和爪子。

ex.en: Organisations should vet potential employees carefully when recruiting people who will work with children or vulnerable adults.
ex.zh: 组织在招聘将与儿童或弱势成年人接触的人员时，应仔细审查应聘者。

col: take a pet to the vet｜带宠物看兽医
tip: 动词过去式vetted，动名词vetting，均双写t。

senses.en: Extremely beautiful, grand, or impressive.
Exceptionally good or skilfully done.

ex.en: The balcony offers a magnificent view of snowy mountains.
ex.zh: 从阳台可以欣赏到壮丽的雪山景色。

ex.en: Preserving magnificent historic buildings can strengthen local identity and attract visitors from other regions.
ex.zh: 保护宏伟的历史建筑能增强当地认同感，并吸引其他地区的游客。

tip: 多形容景色、建筑或成就，不表示品德高尚。

senses.en: people born and living at roughly the same time
the process of producing something, especially electricity
a stage in the development of a product or technology

ex.en: Three generations of our family gathered for dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们家三代人聚在一起吃晚饭。

ex.en: Each generation faces different challenges as technological progress changes the skills required in the workplace.
ex.zh: 随着技术进步改变职场所需的技能，每一代人都面临不同的挑战。

tip: 表示“一代人”时可数；表示“产生”时通常不可数。

senses.en: A place providing medical advice or treatment without overnight stays.

ex.en: The clinic near our house opens early on weekdays.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的诊所工作日很早就开门。

ex.en: Local clinics can reduce pressure on hospitals by treating common illnesses and providing preventive care.
ex.zh: 当地诊所可以通过治疗常见病和提供预防性保健来减轻医院的压力。

tip: clinic指诊所或门诊部；“临床的”用clinical。

senses.en: to arrange for something to happen later than originally planned

ex.en: We postponed our picnic because heavy rain was forecast.
ex.zh: 因为天气预报说有大雨，我们推迟了野餐。

ex.en: Local authorities decided to postpone construction until a full assessment of the environmental impact was completed.
ex.zh: 地方当局决定推迟施工，直到完成全面的环境影响评估。

col: postpone until further notice｜延期至另行通知
tip: 后接名词或动名词：postpone doing，不接to do。

senses.en: illegal activities considered as a whole
an action that breaks the law

ex.en: Better street lighting has helped reduce crime here.
ex.zh: 更好的街道照明帮助减少了这里的犯罪。

ex.en: Investment in education and employment opportunities may reduce crime more effectively than increasingly severe punishments.
ex.zh: 投资教育和增加就业机会，可能比不断加重惩罚更有效地减少犯罪。

tip: 泛指犯罪不可数；指具体罪行可数，如commit a crime。

senses.en: to get away from confinement or a dangerous situation
to avoid something unpleasant or harmful
the act of getting free from danger or unpleasant conditions

ex.en: Our rabbit escaped through a small gap in the fence.
ex.zh: 我们的兔子从围栏的一处小缝隙逃走了。

ex.en: Accessible parks offer urban residents an escape from crowded streets and opportunities to enjoy nature.
ex.zh: 便利可达的公园让城市居民得以远离拥挤的街道，并有机会亲近自然。

tip: 逃离某处用escape from；免遭某事可直接接名词。

senses.en: Between basic and advanced levels, or between two stages.
A learner whose skills are between beginner and advanced levels.

ex.en: This swimming class is suitable for intermediate learners.
ex.zh: 这门游泳课适合中级学员。

ex.en: Intermediate language courses should balance grammar instruction with opportunities for meaningful communication outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 中级语言课程应兼顾语法教学与课堂外有实际意义的交流机会。

tip: 常指介于beginner与advanced之间的水平。

senses.en: not cooked
in its original state before processing or analysis
sore because the skin is damaged or irritated

ex.en: I prefer raw carrots because they are so crunchy.
ex.zh: 我更喜欢生胡萝卜，因为吃起来很脆。

ex.en: Countries that export mainly raw materials may be vulnerable to sudden changes in global commodity prices.
ex.zh: 主要出口原材料的国家可能容易受到全球大宗商品价格骤变的冲击。

tip: raw强调未烹煮或未加工，不等于“新鲜的”fresh。

senses.en: to officially allow someone to do something
an official document allowing a particular activity
to make an action or situation possible

ex.en: The museum permits visitors to take photos without flash.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆允许游客在不开闪光灯的情况下拍照。

ex.en: Local authorities should permit new housing developments only when adequate transport and healthcare services are available.
ex.zh: 地方政府只有在交通和医疗服务充足时，才应批准新的住宅开发项目。

col: permit someone to do something｜允许某人做某事
tip: 动词重音在后，名词在前；permit sb to do。

senses.en: to take one number or amount away from another

ex.en: Subtract the delivery charge to find the original price.
ex.zh: 减去运费，就能算出原价。

ex.en: Researchers subtract production costs from total revenue to calculate the profit generated by each farming method.
ex.zh: 研究人员从总收入中减去生产成本，计算每种耕作方式带来的利润。

tip: subtract A from B 表示用B减去A。

senses.en: right for a particular person, purpose, or situation

ex.en: These walking shoes are suitable for muddy forest paths.
ex.zh: 这双步行鞋适合走泥泞的林间小路。

ex.en: Cities should provide suitable housing for older residents, with easy access to healthcare and public transport.
ex.zh: 城市应为老年居民提供合适的住房，方便他们就医和乘坐公共交通。

col: a suitable candidate｜合适的候选人
tip: 常用suitable for sb/sth或suitable to do sth。

senses.en: a deep pan with a handle for cooking

ex.en: She boiled the soup in a saucepan.
ex.zh: 她用炖锅煮汤。

ex.en: Put the saucepan on the stove, please.
ex.zh: 请把炖锅放到炉子上。

tip: saucepan 是带柄的深锅，用来煮汤/炖菜。
scene: A saucepan with soup boiling on a stove.

senses.en: Food with a pastry base or covering and a filling.

ex.en: We shared a warm apple pie after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们分着吃了一个热苹果派。

ex.en: Traditional dishes, such as fruit pie, can help preserve regional food culture across generations.
ex.zh: 水果派等传统菜肴有助于让地方饮食文化代代相传。

col: a slice of pie｜一块馅饼
tip: pie指馅饼；“饼图”须说pie chart。

senses.en: A tropical forest with thick, closely growing plants and trees
A confusing or dangerous situation involving fierce competition

ex.en: Thick vines hung above the narrow jungle path.
ex.zh: 茂密的藤蔓垂在狭窄的丛林小路上方。

ex.en: Clearing jungle for agriculture destroys wildlife habitats and can reduce biodiversity across an entire region.
ex.zh: 清除热带丛林以开辟农田会破坏野生动物栖息地，并可能降低整个地区的生物多样性。

tip: 通常指热带的茂密丛林；forest泛指森林。

senses.en: a person who writes computer programs

ex.en: She works as a programmer for a tech company.
ex.zh: 她在一家科技公司当程序员。

ex.en: The programmer fixed the problem in the app.
ex.zh: 程序员修复了应用里的问题。

tip: programmer 是程序员；美式拼写也作 programmer。
scene: A programmer typing code on a computer with two screens.

senses.en: The act of focusing your mind on someone or something.
Care or action given to someone or something that needs it.

ex.en: Please pay attention while I explain the game.
ex.zh: 我讲解游戏规则时，请认真听。

ex.en: Schools should give greater attention to students' emotional wellbeing alongside their academic progress.
ex.zh: 学校在关注学生学业进展的同时，也应更加重视他们的情绪健康。

tip: pay attention to后接名词或动名词，to是介词。

senses.en: To establish that something is true or correct.
To make an arrangement certain or give it official approval.

ex.en: Please call the hotel to confirm our booking today.
ex.zh: 请今天给酒店打电话，确认我们的预订。

ex.en: Further research is needed to confirm whether smaller classes consistently improve learning outcomes in primary schools.
ex.zh: 还需要进一步研究，以证实小学小班教学是否能持续改善学习效果。

tip: 可接名词或that从句；不要用confirm to do。

senses.en: The natural outer covering of a person's or animal's body.
The thin outer layer of certain fruits and vegetables.
Remove the skin from an animal, fruit or vegetable.

ex.en: My skin feels dry after swimming in the pool.
ex.zh: 在泳池游泳后，我觉得皮肤很干。

ex.en: Protecting skin from excessive sunlight can reduce the risk of serious health problems later in life.
ex.zh: 保护皮肤免受过度日晒，可以降低日后出现严重健康问题的风险。

tip: 指人体皮肤通常不可数；一张兽皮可数。

senses.en: To find the exact position of someone or something.
To place something or establish a business somewhere.

ex.en: We finally located the missing keys behind the sofa.
ex.zh: 我们终于在沙发后面找到了丢失的钥匙。

ex.en: Local authorities should locate new health centres near public transport routes to improve access for elderly residents.
ex.zh: 地方政府应将新的医疗中心设在公共交通线路附近，以方便老年居民就医。

col: locate a fault｜查明故障位置
tip: 表示“位于”常用be located in/near，不直接用locate。

senses.en: a small pointed metal object used to hold things together
to fasten something with a pin or similar object
to hold someone or something firmly so movement is impossible

ex.en: She used a pin to hold the fabric together.
ex.zh: 她用一枚大头针把布料固定在一起。

ex.en: Teachers can pin students' artwork to classroom walls to celebrate creativity and encourage participation.
ex.zh: 教师可以把学生的美术作品钉在教室墙上，以肯定创造力并鼓励参与。

col: pin something to｜把某物钉在……上
tip: pin作动词时，过去式pinned，进行式pinning。

senses.en: causing physical pain or hurting

senses.zh: 令人痛苦的；令人难堪的
senses.en: causing sadness, distress, or embarrassment

ex.en: My ankle is still painful when I climb stairs.
ex.zh: 我上楼梯时，脚踝还是很疼。

ex.en: For many workers, losing a secure job is a painful experience that affects both confidence and financial stability.
ex.zh: 对许多劳动者而言，失去稳定工作是一段痛苦的经历，既影响信心，也影响经济稳定。

col: a painful injury｜令人疼痛的伤
tip: painful可指身体疼痛，也可指情感痛苦或难堪。

senses.en: To form an opinion after considering someone or something.
An official who oversees court proceedings and makes legal decisions.
Someone who assesses performances or decides the winner of a competition.

ex.en: Don't judge the soup until you have tasted it.
ex.zh: 先尝尝这汤，再评价它。

ex.en: Schools should judge students on a range of abilities rather than relying entirely on examination results.
ex.zh: 学校应根据学生的多方面能力作出评价，而不是完全依赖考试成绩。

tip: judge A by B表示依据B判断A。

senses.en: something you should do because it is right or required
work required by a job or a period of service
a tax charged on certain goods

ex.en: It is my duty to keep these animals safe.
ex.zh: 保护这些动物的安全是我的责任。

ex.en: Governments have a duty to protect vulnerable citizens while ensuring that public services remain financially sustainable.
ex.zh: 政府有责任保护弱势公民，同时确保公共服务在财政上可持续。

tip: on duty指值班；具体岗位职责常用复数duties。

senses.en: a formal request for a job, place, or permission
the practical use of knowledge, skills, or methods
a computer program designed to perform particular tasks

ex.en: I sent my job application before breakfast this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早饭前，我提交了求职申请。

ex.en: Simplifying the application process could encourage more students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for university scholarships.
ex.zh: 简化申请流程可能鼓励更多来自弱势家庭的学生申请大学奖学金。

tip: 申请某物用application for，向机构申请用to。

senses.en: In a truthful way, without lying or cheating.
Used to emphasize sincerity or introduce a frank opinion.

ex.en: Please answer honestly: did you enjoy the soup?
ex.zh: 请坦白回答：你喜欢这道汤吗？

ex.en: Companies that communicate honestly about environmental challenges are more likely to earn lasting public trust.
ex.zh: 坦诚说明环境挑战的企业更有可能赢得公众的长期信任。

tip: honestly重在诚实；表示公正通常用fairly。

senses.en: The joint where your leg bends in the middle.

ex.en: She bent her knee gently before starting the exercise.
ex.zh: 开始锻炼前，她轻轻弯了弯膝盖。

ex.en: Regular low-impact exercise can strengthen the muscles around the knee and help maintain mobility in older adults.
ex.zh: 经常进行低冲击运动可以增强膝关节周围的肌肉，帮助老年人保持行动能力。

tip: 词首k不发音；复数knees读作/niːz/。

senses.en: the period of life when someone is a child

ex.en: My happiest childhood memories involve baking with my grandmother.
ex.zh: 我最快乐的童年记忆都与和祖母一起烘焙有关。

ex.en: Access to safe outdoor spaces during childhood can support physical development and emotional wellbeing.
ex.zh: 童年时期能够使用安全的户外空间，有助于身体发育和心理健康。

tip: during childhood泛指童年；in my childhood指我的童年。

senses.en: Having many connected parts and therefore difficult to understand or manage.

ex.en: This recipe is too complicated for a quick lunch.
ex.zh: 这道菜的做法太复杂，不适合赶时间做午饭。

ex.en: Complicated application procedures may discourage eligible students from seeking financial support for their university studies.
ex.zh: 复杂的申请程序可能使符合条件的学生不愿申请大学学业资助。

tip: 强调复杂难懂；complex也可仅指结构复杂。

senses.en: The short, thick finger on the side of your hand.
To turn pages quickly without reading everything carefully.

ex.en: I accidentally hit my thumb while hanging a picture.
ex.zh: 挂画时，我不小心砸到了拇指。

ex.en: Many readers thumb through printed magazines before deciding which articles deserve their full attention.
ex.zh: 许多读者会先快速翻阅纸质杂志，再决定仔细阅读哪些文章。

col: a rule of thumb｜经验法则
tip: b不发音；thumb through表示快速翻阅。

senses.en: With an audible voice rather than silently.

ex.en: Please read the recipe aloud while I mix.
ex.zh: 我搅拌的时候，请把食谱读出来。

ex.en: Reading stories aloud can help young children develop vocabulary and strengthen their understanding of spoken language.
ex.zh: 大声朗读故事可以帮助幼儿积累词汇，并增强他们对口语的理解。

tip: aloud强调发出声音，不一定像loudly那样响亮。

senses.en: a business that provides goods or professional services
solid and not easily moved or pressed out of shape
unlikely to change a decision or allow rules to be broken

ex.en: My sister works for a small engineering firm.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在一家小型工程公司工作。

ex.en: Each firm should provide regular training to help employees adapt to technological change.
ex.zh: 每家公司都应提供定期培训，帮助员工适应技术变革。

col: take a firm stand｜采取坚定立场
tip: 作名词指公司；作形容词可指物体结实或态度坚定。

senses.en: Clothes and other fabrics waiting to be washed or freshly washed.
The activity of washing clothes, or a place providing this service.

ex.en: Please put your dirty laundry in the basket.
ex.zh: 请把脏衣服放进篮子里。

ex.en: Shared laundry facilities can reduce water consumption and save space in modern apartment buildings.
ex.zh: 共用洗衣设施可以减少用水量，并节省现代公寓楼的空间。

tip: 表示衣物或洗衣这件事时通常不可数。

senses.en: The space something occupies, or the total amount of something.
The level of loudness of a sound.
A book, especially one belonging to a larger set.

ex.en: Please turn the volume down while the baby sleeps.
ex.zh: 宝宝睡觉时请把音量调低。

ex.en: The growing volume of household waste highlights the need for better recycling facilities in urban areas.
ex.zh: 不断增加的生活垃圾量凸显了城市地区改善回收设施的必要性。

col: a high volume of traffic｜很大的交通流量
turn down the volume｜调低音量
tip: volume可指体积、总量或音量；面积用area。

senses.en: to happen

ex.en: The concert will take place in the town hall.
ex.zh: 音乐会将市政厅举行。

ex.en: The meeting took place last Friday.
ex.zh: 会议上周五举行。

tip: take place 表示“发生/举行”，比 happen 更正式。
scene: A concert taking place in a town hall with an audience.

senses.en: not wanting to learn about or take part in something

ex.en: Leo seemed uninterested in the game and went outside.
ex.zh: 利奥似乎对游戏不感兴趣，便出去了。

ex.en: Students may appear uninterested in science when lessons offer few opportunities for practical experiments.
ex.zh: 如果课堂很少提供动手实验的机会，学生可能会显得对科学不感兴趣。

col: uninterested in politics｜对政治不感兴趣
tip: 接in；勿与表示“公正无私”的disinterested混淆。

senses.en: Extremely small in size or amount.

ex.en: A tiny frog jumped out of the flower pot.
ex.zh: 一只小小的青蛙从花盆里跳了出来。

ex.en: Even tiny changes in daily habits can reduce household energy consumption over time.
ex.zh: 即使日常习惯的微小改变，长期下来也能减少家庭能源消耗。

tip: 比small语气更强，强调小得惊人。

senses.en: Very unhappy or uncomfortable
Extremely unpleasant or of very poor quality

ex.en: I felt miserable when rain ruined our picnic plans.
ex.zh: 大雨毁了我们的野餐计划，让我很难过。

ex.en: Overcrowded housing can create miserable living conditions and negatively affect residents' physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 住房过度拥挤会造成恶劣的生活条件，并损害居民的身心健康。

tip: 既可形容人的心情，也可形容天气或生活条件。

senses.en: ready and happy to do something
eager to help or work without needing persuasion

ex.en: I'm willing to help you move this weekend.
ex.zh: 我愿意这周末帮你搬家。

ex.en: Consumers may be more willing to buy sustainable products if prices remain affordable and information is clear.
ex.zh: 如果价格仍可负担且信息清晰，消费者可能更愿意购买可持续产品。

col: be willing to do something｜愿意做某事
a willing volunteer｜热心的志愿者
a willing helper｜乐于帮忙的人
tip: 常用be willing to do，表示愿意，不等于将要。

senses.en: Entertainment and social activities available in a place at night

ex.en: We enjoyed the city's nightlife after dinner by the river.
ex.zh: 在河边吃过晚饭后，我们体验了这座城市的夜生活。

ex.en: A vibrant nightlife can attract tourists and create jobs, but noise may disturb local residents.
ex.zh: 丰富的夜生活可以吸引游客并创造就业机会，但噪声可能扰民。

col: vibrant nightlife｜充满活力的夜生活
tip: nightlife通常不可数，指夜间社交娱乐活动。

senses.en: Covered with ice.
Extremely cold.
Showing no warmth or friendliness.

ex.en: We walked slowly along the icy path this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，我们沿着结冰的小路慢慢走。

ex.en: Local authorities should treat icy roads promptly to reduce accidents and maintain reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 地方政府应及时处理结冰路面，以减少事故并保障公共交通可靠运行。

col: an icy stare｜冷冰冰的凝视
tip: icy既可指覆冰或极冷，也可形容态度冷漠。

senses.en: to have the appearance of, or seem

ex.en: He looks like his father.
ex.zh: 他长得像他爸爸。

ex.en: It looks like it's going to snow.
ex.zh: 看起来要下雪了。

tip: look like 表示“长得像/看起来像”。
scene: A boy and his father standing side by side, looking alike.

senses.en: the place in a shop where you pay

ex.en: The checkout has a long queue today.
ex.zh: 今天收银台排着长队。

ex.en: She put her shopping on the checkout counter.
ex.zh: 她把买的东西放在收银台上。

tip: checkout 是超市/商店的收银结账处。
scene: A supermarket checkout counter with a cashier and groceries.

senses.en: not common or not happening often
cooked briefly so the inside remains red

ex.en: We spotted a rare bird beside the lake yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在湖边发现了一只罕见的鸟。

ex.en: Protecting rare species requires long-term investment in habitat restoration and effective controls on illegal trade.
ex.zh: 保护稀有物种需要长期投资于栖息地修复，并有效管制非法贸易。

tip: rare形容肉时指内部仍红，熟度低于medium。

senses.en: A legally binding agreement between people or organisations.
To become smaller or make something smaller.
To catch or develop a disease.

ex.en: Read the contract carefully before you agree to sign it.
ex.zh: 同意签字之前，要仔细阅读合同。

ex.en: A clear employment contract protects both workers and employers by defining responsibilities, working hours and payment terms.
ex.zh: 明确的劳动合同通过规定职责、工作时间和薪酬条款，保护员工和雇主双方的权益。

tip: 名词重音在前；动词英/kənˈtrækt/，美同。

senses.en: a machine that gives you money from your bank account

ex.en: I got some money from the cash machine.
ex.zh: 我从取款机取了些钱。

ex.en: The cash machine is outside the bank.
ex.zh: 取款机在银行外面。

tip: cash machine 是英式说法；美式常说 ATM。
scene: A person using an ATM machine on a street to get cash.

senses.en: The absence of something or not having enough of it
Not have something necessary or enough of it

ex.en: A lack of sleep made me tired all morning.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足让我整个上午都很疲惫。

ex.en: Many rural schools lack the resources needed to provide students with practical science lessons.
ex.zh: 许多乡村学校缺少为学生开设科学实践课所需的资源。

col: a lack of resources｜资源短缺
for lack of funding｜因缺少资金
a lack of sleep｜睡眠不足
tip: 名词用a lack of；动词直接接宾语，不加of。

senses.en: Unable to hear, or able to hear very little.

ex.en: My deaf cousin taught me some useful everyday signs.
ex.zh: 我失聪的表亲教了我一些实用的日常手语。

ex.en: Providing captions and sign language interpretation can make public information more accessible to deaf people.
ex.zh: 提供字幕和手语翻译可以让聋人更方便地获取公共信息。

tip: 读音同def；大写Deaf可强调聋人文化身份。

senses.en: A feeling of uncertainty about whether something is true or possible.
To feel uncertain about something or think it unlikely.

ex.en: I doubt the shop is still open this late.
ex.zh: 这么晚了，我觉得那家店大概已经关门了。

ex.en: There is little doubt that access to clean water is essential for improving public health.
ex.zh: 毫无疑问，获得清洁用水对于改善公共卫生至关重要。

tip: b不发音；I doubt that常表示认为某事不大可能。

senses.en: feeling ill or not in good health

ex.en: I felt unwell and went home before lunch.
ex.zh: 我感觉身体不适，午饭前就回家了。

ex.en: Employees who feel unwell should be encouraged to stay home to prevent infections spreading at work.
ex.zh: 应鼓励身体不适的员工居家休息，以防感染在工作场所传播。

tip: 常放在feel或be后作表语，不常放在名词前。

senses.en: existing at the beginning, before any changes
new and different rather than copied from something else
the first version from which copies are made

ex.en: The kitchen still has its original wooden floor.
ex.zh: 厨房仍保留着原来的木地板。

ex.en: Schools should encourage original thinking rather than reward students only for repeating information from textbooks.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励独创性思考，而不是只奖励复述课本知识的学生。

tip: 可指最初的，也可指原创的；看语境区分。

senses.en: Relating to people rather than animals or machines.
A person, as distinct from an animal or machine.

ex.en: This robot can recognise a familiar human voice.
ex.zh: 这个机器人能识别熟悉的人声。

ex.en: Human activity has significantly altered natural habitats, making wildlife conservation an urgent priority for governments.
ex.zh: 人类活动已显著改变自然栖息地，使野生动物保护成为各国政府迫切需要优先处理的事项。

tip: human是“人类的”；humane是“人道的”。

senses.en: a situation without war, fighting, or serious disagreement
a state of quietness or freedom from worry

ex.en: I enjoy the peace of this garden before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我喜欢早餐前这座花园里的宁静。

ex.en: Lasting peace depends on cooperation between communities and fair access to essential resources.
ex.zh: 持久和平有赖于各群体之间的合作以及公平获取基本资源的机会。

tip: 通常不可数；peace of mind表示安心、心安。

senses.en: A moving ridge of water or a travelling energy disturbance.
To move a hand or object repeatedly as a signal.
A sudden increase or spread of something.

ex.en: A huge wave washed over our little sandcastle.
ex.zh: 一个大浪冲过了我们的小沙堡。

ex.en: Coastal wetlands can absorb wave energy, helping to protect nearby settlements from erosion and storm damage.
ex.zh: 沿海湿地能够吸收波浪能量，帮助保护附近居民区免受侵蚀和风暴破坏。

col: a wave of protests｜一波抗议
tip: 向某人挥手用wave at或wave to someone。

senses.en: A period of two weeks.

ex.en: We're spending a fortnight by the sea this summer.
ex.zh: 今年夏天我们要在海边待两周。

ex.en: Allowing employees to work remotely for a fortnight could help employers evaluate the benefits of flexible working.
ex.zh: 允许员工远程工作两周，可以帮助雇主评估灵活办公的益处。

tip: 主要用于英式英语；美式通常说two weeks。

senses.en: using the name of a person or thing

ex.en: The teacher knows every student by name.
ex.zh: 老师认识每个学生的名字。

ex.en: Please address the letter to me by name.
ex.zh: 请把信写上我的名字寄给我。

tip: know sb by name 是“知道某人的名字”。
scene: A teacher calling a student's name from a class list.

senses.en: a report about tomorrow's weather

ex.en: The weather forecast says it will be sunny tomorrow.
ex.zh: 天气预报说明天晴朗。

ex.en: We watched the weather forecast before the trip.
ex.zh: 旅行前我们看了天气预报。

tip: weather forecast 是天气预报；forecast 也作动词“预报”。
scene: A TV weather presenter pointing at a sunny forecast map.

senses.en: anything that; no matter what
any kind of something, without restriction

ex.en: You can choose whatever you like for dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚餐你想吃什么都可以选。

ex.en: Whatever their background, students should have equal access to high-quality education and appropriate learning support.
ex.zh: 无论背景如何，学生都应平等地获得优质教育和适当的学习支持。

col: whatever the reason｜无论原因是什么
whatever you like｜任何你喜欢的东西
tip: whatever不限范围；whichever常指限定范围内任选。

senses.en: A person connected to you by blood or marriage.
Judged by comparison rather than by a fixed standard.

ex.en: A relative brought us homemade bread during the holidays.
ex.zh: 假期里，一位亲戚给我们带来了自制面包。

ex.en: The relative cost of public transport influences whether residents choose buses over private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通的相对费用会影响居民是否选择公交车而非私家车。

tip: 作名词指亲属；作形容词常与to连用表示比较。

senses.en: to have finished

ex.en: The lesson is over at half past three.
ex.zh: 课三点半结束。

ex.en: When the film was over, we went home.
ex.zh: 电影结束后我们回家了。

tip: be over 表示“结束”；The concert is over. 音乐会结束了。
scene: A classroom clock showing the end of a lesson as students pack up.

senses.en: To move continuously, like water through a channel.
Continuous movement, or the amount moving through a place.

ex.en: Rainwater flowed down the path and into the garden.
ex.zh: 雨水沿着小路流进了花园。

ex.en: Improved public transport can ease the flow of traffic and reduce air pollution in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以使交通更加顺畅，并减少拥挤城市的空气污染。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为flowed，不是flew。

senses.en: feeling strong love for someone

ex.en: They are deeply in love with each other.
ex.zh: 他们深深相爱。

ex.en: She fell in love with the city at first sight.
ex.zh: 她第一眼就爱上了这座城市。

tip: fall in love with 是“爱上”；be in love 是“恋爱中”。
scene: A couple holding hands and smiling on a park bench.

senses.en: to take hold of something suddenly or firmly
to get food, drink, or something else quickly
to attract someone's attention strongly

ex.en: She grabbed her umbrella and ran towards the bus.
ex.zh: 她抓起雨伞，朝公交车跑去。

ex.en: Public health campaigns often use striking images to grab attention and encourage people to change unhealthy habits.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传常用醒目的图片吸引注意，鼓励人们改变不健康的习惯。

col: grab someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意
grab a bite｜匆忙吃点东西
tip: grab较口语化；过去式grabbed，分词grabbing。

senses.en: broken or harmed

ex.en: The damaged bike cannot be ridden anymore.
ex.zh: 这辆损坏的自行车不能再骑了。

ex.en: She returned the damaged phone to the shop.
ex.zh: 她把损坏的手机退回商店。

tip: damaged 是过去分词作形容词“受损的”。
scene: A bicycle with a bent wheel lying beside a wall.

senses.en: Often or many times

ex.en: Our neighbour frequently brings us vegetables from her garden.
ex.zh: 邻居经常给我们送来她园子里种的蔬菜。

ex.en: People who frequently use public transport may spend less on travel than those who drive daily.
ex.zh: 经常使用公共交通的人，出行开支可能低于每天开车的人。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后，与often近义。

senses.en: a machine that sends copies of documents by phone lines

ex.en: Please send the form by fax.
ex.zh: 请把表格用传真发过来。

ex.en: She faxed the contract to the office.
ex.zh: 她把合同传真到办公室。

tip: fax 可作名词“传真”或动词“发传真”。
scene: An office fax machine sending out a sheet of paper.

senses.en: to raise something, or to delay

ex.en: Hold up your hand if you have a question.
ex.zh: 有问题请举手。

ex.en: The traffic was held up by an accident.
ex.zh: 交通因事故延误了。

tip: hold up 有“举起、延误、抢劫”等多个意思。
scene: A student raising their hand high in a classroom.

senses.en: usually, or in most situations
in the usual, expected, or healthy way

ex.en: I normally walk to work unless it rains heavily.
ex.zh: 除非下大雨，我通常步行上班。

ex.en: Students normally benefit from regular feedback, especially when teachers provide clear guidance on improving their work.
ex.zh: 学生通常能从定期反馈中受益，尤其是在教师明确指导他们改进作业时。

tip: 既可表频率“通常”，也可表状态“正常地”。

senses.en: At the present time, especially compared with the past.

ex.en: Nowadays, I usually pay for groceries with my phone.
ex.zh: 如今，我买食品杂货通常用手机付款。

ex.en: Nowadays, many employees expect flexible working arrangements that allow them to balance professional and family responsibilities.
ex.zh: 如今，许多员工希望有灵活的工作安排，以便兼顾工作和家庭责任。

col: rarely used nowadays｜如今很少使用
tip: 常与一般现在时连用，强调今昔对比；不用加介词。

senses.en: A sweet substance chewed but not swallowed
The firm pink flesh surrounding the bases of teeth
A sticky substance from plants, often used for making glue

ex.en: She offered me a piece of mint gum.
ex.zh: 她给了我一片薄荷口香糖。

ex.en: Regular dental checkups can help detect gum disease before it causes serious damage.
ex.zh: 定期进行牙科检查有助于在牙龈疾病造成严重损害前发现问题。

col: a piece of gum｜一片口香糖
tip: 口香糖不可数；牙龈通常用复数gums。

senses.en: all people living in an area, or their total number
all organisms of one species living in a particular area

ex.en: The village population grows when families move here.
ex.zh: 有家庭搬来时，村里的人口就会增加。

ex.en: An ageing population can place additional pressure on healthcare systems and increase demand for accessible public transport.
ex.zh: 人口老龄化会给医疗系统带来额外压力，并增加对无障碍公共交通的需求。

tip: 人口多或少用large或small，不用many或few。

senses.en: Belonging or relating to one particular person.
Concerning someone's private life rather than public matters.

senses.zh: 针对个人的；人身攻击的
senses.en: Directed at someone's character rather than their ideas or actions.

ex.en: Please keep your personal belongings close while boarding the train.
ex.zh: 上火车时，请将个人物品放在身边。

ex.en: Online services should protect personal information and explain clearly how they collect and use customer data.
ex.zh: 在线服务应保护个人信息，并清楚说明如何收集和使用客户数据。

tip: personal指个人的；personnel指全体员工，注意拼写。

senses.en: except for, or in addition to

ex.en: Apart from the weather, the trip was perfect.
ex.zh: 除了天气，这次旅行很完美。

ex.en: Everyone came to the party apart from Tom.
ex.zh: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加聚会了。

tip: apart from 既可表“除了…之外（排除）”，也可表“除了…还（补充）”。
scene: A sunny picnic with an empty chair, everyone there apart from one person.

senses.en: an organisation that helps people or causes in need
help, especially money, given to those in need

ex.en: My sister volunteers at a charity that rescues dogs.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在一家救助狗的慈善机构做志愿者。

ex.en: Local charities can provide essential support, but governments remain responsible for ensuring access to basic services.
ex.zh: 地方慈善机构可以提供重要支持，但政府仍有责任保障基本服务的可及性。

col: donate to charity｜向慈善事业捐款
raise money for charity｜为慈善事业筹款
tip: 指机构时可数；指慈善事业或救济时不可数。

senses.en: A soft filled bag used for comfort or support.
To soften an impact or reduce a harmful effect.
Something that protects against difficulty, loss, or sudden change.

ex.en: She put a soft cushion behind her back.
ex.zh: 她在背后放了一个柔软的靠垫。

ex.en: Emergency savings can cushion the financial impact of unemployment and help families maintain their living standards.
ex.zh: 应急储蓄可以减轻失业带来的经济冲击，帮助家庭维持生活水平。

tip: 动词常搭配impact或blow，表示减轻冲击。

senses.en: to take something away from where it is
to get rid of something unwanted
to make someone leave a job or position

ex.en: Please remove your shoes before stepping onto the new carpet.
ex.zh: 踩上新地毯前，请先脱鞋。

ex.en: Governments should remove unnecessary barriers that prevent qualified workers from entering the labour market.
ex.zh: 政府应消除阻碍合格劳动者进入劳动力市场的不必要障碍。

col: remove someone from office｜免去某人职务
tip: 常用 remove A from B，表示从B中移除A。

senses.en: To become impossible to see or find.
To stop existing.

ex.en: We watched the boat disappear into the thick fog.
ex.zh: 我们看着小船消失在浓雾中。

ex.en: Many traditional crafts may disappear unless governments support skilled workers and encourage younger generations to learn them.
ex.zh: 除非政府支持技艺工人并鼓励年轻一代学习，否则许多传统手艺可能消失。

col: disappear from view｜从视野中消失
disappear without a trace｜消失得无影无踪
tip: 通常是不及物动词，不说 be disappeared。

senses.en: done using hands, not a machine

ex.en: The card was made by hand.
ex.zh: 这张卡片是手工制作的。

ex.en: Please sign the form by hand.
ex.zh: 请用手写签名。

tip: by hand 表示“手工地”；made by hand 手工制作。
scene: Hands folding a paper card with craft materials on a table.

senses.en: now, at this time

ex.en: At present, she is studying in London.
ex.zh: 目前她在伦敦学习。

ex.en: At present, the shop is closed for repairs.
ex.zh: 目前这家店因装修停业。

tip: at present 是书面语“目前”，等于 now/currently。
scene: A London study desk with books, a girl studying at a window.

senses.en: Lasting for only a limited period of time.

ex.en: This temporary desk will do until the new one arrives.
ex.zh: 新书桌送来之前，先用这张临时桌子就行。

ex.en: Temporary accommodation provides essential shelter while families wait for suitable permanent housing to become available.
ex.zh: 在家庭等待合适的永久住房期间，临时住处提供了必要的栖身之所。

tip: 强调持续时间有限，反义词为permanent。

senses.en: relating to crime or the legal treatment of crime
a person who has committed a crime

ex.en: The police found evidence of criminal activity in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 警方在仓库里发现了犯罪活动的证据。

ex.en: Education and employment programmes may reduce criminal behaviour by providing young people with better opportunities.
ex.zh: 教育和就业项目可以为年轻人提供更好的机会，从而可能减少犯罪行为。

col: criminal justice system｜刑事司法体系
tip: criminal 可作形容词或名词；crime 是“罪行”。

senses.en: Make someone interested in or drawn towards something
Pull something closer through a physical force

ex.en: The bright flowers attract butterflies to our small balcony.
ex.zh: 鲜艳的花朵把蝴蝶吸引到我们的小阳台上。

ex.en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport are more likely to attract businesses and skilled workers.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市更有可能吸引企业和技术人才。

tip: attract是及物动词，直接接人或事物作宾语。

senses.en: small money given to children by parents

ex.en: She saves her pocket money to buy books.
ex.zh: 她存零花钱买书。

ex.en: My pocket money is ten pounds a week.
ex.zh: 我的零花钱是每周十英镑。

tip: pocket money 是孩子每周的零花钱；美式说 allowance。
scene: A parent giving coins to a happy child.

senses.en: to control equipment, or to work as a machine
to run a business or provide a service
to perform surgery on a patient

ex.en: Can you show me how to operate this printer?
ex.zh: 你能教我怎么操作这台打印机吗？

ex.en: Companies that operate in rural areas often face higher transport costs and limited access to skilled workers.
ex.zh: 在农村地区经营的公司往往面临较高的运输成本，而且难以找到技术熟练的员工。

col: operate on a patient｜给病人做手术
tip: 操作机器直接接宾语；给某人做手术用operate on。

senses.en: A fight between armed forces.
A difficult struggle to achieve something or overcome a problem.
To struggle hard against someone or something.

ex.en: The museum displays armour from a famous battle.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了某场著名战役中使用的盔甲。

ex.en: The battle against air pollution requires coordinated action from governments, businesses, and individuals across urban areas.
ex.zh: 对抗空气污染需要城市各地的政府、企业和个人协调行动。

col: battle against pollution｜与污染作斗争
battle for survival｜为生存而斗争
tip: battle可指具体战斗，也常比喻与疾病或困难抗争。

senses.en: Not needed or serving no useful purpose.

ex.en: Bring a light jacket, but heavy boots are unnecessary.
ex.zh: 带一件薄外套吧，但厚靴子就没必要了。

ex.en: Clear instructions can prevent unnecessary delays and help public services operate more efficiently.
ex.zh: 清晰的指引可以避免不必要的延误，帮助公共服务更高效地运作。

col: avoid unnecessary delays｜避免不必要的延误
tip: 表示“没必要做”可用 it is unnecessary to do。

senses.en: To make something less enjoyable, useful, or attractive.
To give someone excessive attention or everything they want.
To become, or make food become, unfit to eat.

ex.en: Please don't spoil the surprise by telling your sister.
ex.zh: 请别告诉你姐姐，免得破坏这份惊喜。

ex.en: Poorly planned construction can spoil natural landscapes and reduce their appeal to both residents and tourists.
ex.zh: 规划不当的建设会破坏自然景观，降低其对居民和游客的吸引力。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均可用spoiled或spoilt。

senses.en: To lose blood from a wound or inside the body.

ex.en: My finger started to bleed after a small paper cut.
ex.zh: 我的手指被纸轻轻划了一下，开始流血了。

ex.en: First aid courses teach people how to respond safely when minor injuries cause someone to bleed.
ex.zh: 急救课程教人们在轻伤导致出血时如何安全应对。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bled；blood是名词“血”。

senses.en: despite the fact that

ex.en: Although it was raining, we still walked home.
ex.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是走回了家。

ex.en: Although renewable energy requires substantial initial investment, it can lower electricity costs in the long term.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源需要大量前期投资，但从长远来看，它能降低电力成本。

col: although it is true that｜虽然确实……
although not always｜虽然并非总是
tip: 引导让步从句；同一句通常不再用but连接主句。

senses.en: to prevent something from happening or refrain from doing something
to stay away from someone or something

ex.en: We left early to avoid the morning traffic.
ex.zh: 我们很早就出发了，以避开早高峰的车流。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to avoid further increases in traffic congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 城市应改善公共交通，以避免交通拥堵和空气污染进一步加剧。

tip: 后接名词或动名词：avoid doing，不用to do。

senses.en: Able to produce original ideas, or involving imagination.

ex.en: My creative sister turned old jars into colourful lamps.
ex.zh: 我富有创意的姐姐把旧罐子变成了彩色灯具。

ex.en: Schools should encourage creative thinking by allowing students to explore several solutions to the same problem.
ex.zh: 学校应允许学生探索同一问题的多种解决方案，以鼓励创造性思维。

col: a creative solution｜创新的解决方案
tip: 形容人有创意或方法新颖；名词形式是creativity。

senses.en: to make something completely full

ex.en: We filled up the car with petrol.
ex.zh: 我们把汽车加满了油。

ex.en: Fill up the bottle with water, please.
ex.zh: 请把瓶子装满水。

col: fill up the tank｜加满油箱
tip: fill up 是“装满/加满”；加油时也说 fill it up。
scene: A car being filled with petrol at a station, tank full.

senses.en: An area defined by its features or official boundaries.

ex.en: We found a small bakery in the old market district.
ex.zh: 我们在老市场区找到了一家小面包店。

ex.en: Improving public transport in suburban districts can reduce car dependence and widen access to employment.
ex.zh: 改善郊区的公共交通可以减少对汽车的依赖，并增加就业机会。

tip: 可指行政划分，也可指具有特定功能的城区。

senses.en: affecting or involving most people, things, or situations
describing main points rather than particular details
an officer with a very high rank in the army

ex.en: There was general agreement that the kitchen needed repainting.
ex.zh: 大家普遍同意厨房需要重新刷漆。

ex.en: Although the general standard of education has improved, significant differences remain between urban and rural schools.
ex.zh: 尽管教育总体水平已有提高，城乡学校之间仍存在显著差异。

tip: in general意为“一般来说”，常用于概括。

senses.en: informal way of saying yes

ex.en: 'Are you coming?' 'Yeah, I'll be there.'
ex.zh: “你来吗？”“嗯，我会去的。”

ex.en: Yeah, I really like this song.
ex.zh: 是啊，我真的很喜欢这首歌。

tip: yeah 是 yes 的口语形式，非正式场合用。
scene: A person nodding and saying yeah while talking with a friend.

senses.en: To consider someone or something responsible for a problem.
Responsibility for something bad that has happened.

ex.en: Don't blame me for the broken kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 别把厨房椅子坏了的事怪到我头上。

ex.en: It is unfair to blame individuals alone for environmental problems caused partly by industrial activity.
ex.zh: 环境问题部分由工业活动造成，仅归咎于个人并不公平。

col: blame someone for something｜因某事责怪某人
blame something on someone｜把某事归咎于某人
tip: 人作宾语用blame sb for；事作宾语用blame sth on。
